description: Implement a Go API with screaming-architecture organization: endpoints grouped by bounded context/domain, not by HTTP verbs or technical layers. At least 3 distinct domain modules demonstrating the pattern.

requirements.description: API codebase must follow screaming architecture with endpoints organized by business domain rather than technical concerns. Each domain must be a distinct module with its own handlers, models, and repositories.
requirements.title: Domain-Driven API Structure

validation.notes: Verify each domain module has separate package
Verify API endpoints map to correct domain handlers

title: API Domain Organization
